tagline: Turn your agent groups into tags the whole platform can use.
lore: Sirius, the Dog Star — brightest in the sky, marshalling the lesser stars — here he musters every Tenable agent into its group and tags it.
problem: Your Tenable agent groups already describe how the estate is organized — by site, team or role — but agent groups can't be used everywhere tags can. Scans, dashboards, exports and every hound work from tags, so that structure stays locked inside agent management.
does: Sirius lists your Tenable agent groups live and tags every asset in each group Agent Group : <group name>, matching Tenable's own membership. Pick groups three ways: type a list of names, tick them in a list, or tag every group at once.

glance.caption: Sirius's agent groups: every Tenable agent group pulled live, each one tick away from an Agent Group : <name> tag on all its assets.
glance.note: Screenshot not included: agent groups are pulled live from Tenable, and the test lab has no Tenable connection.

capabilities: agent groups pulled live through navi each time, not a stale copy.
a typed list of group names, a checkbox per group, or every group at once.
navi tags the assets in each group directly, so the tag matches Tenable's own membership.
Agent Group : <name>, consistent across the estate and usable in scans, dashboards and exports.
how: Sirius reads agent groups live through navi and tags with `navi enrich tag --c "Agent Group" --v <name> --group <name>` — one write per group, behind the write gate and a confirm, recorded in the Tagging log.
who: Security operations teams who own the tag estate, and anyone who wants scans and reports scoped by how agents are actually deployed.
better: Group tags give Terminus, Anubis and Sköll a ready-made way to segment the estate. Covenant keeps the group tags current on its schedule, and Garmr clears any that no longer belong.
cta: Let Sirius lay down the structure — the whole pack navigates by the brightest star.
